premise: Snail worries when Flower closes her petals at dusk; he keeps her company all night and sees her open again in the morning.
inspiration: Andersen's The Daisy, turned: the small watcher at the flower's side is rewarded, not forgotten, and the morning answers his worry.
lesson: Staying with a friend is a kind thing to do, even when you don't understand.
learning: Many flowers close their petals at night and open them in the morning

en-US.title: Flower Closes at Night
en-US.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.3} {canvas:sunset 0.7 22s} [softly] As the sun went down, {flower:enter} Flower {flower:pulse} turned her face to the last warm light. Then {flower:live hold} she folded her yellow petals up, one by one, into a tight little bud. Slowly, slowly, {snail:enter} Snail came crawling by. {snail:face surprised} [gasps] Flower? {snail:shake} Are you all right? But Flower didn't answer. {canvas:night 0.7 20s} {snail:face sad} [sad] Snail didn't know what to do. So he stayed. All night he sat beside her. {sfx:crickets} The crickets sang. The moon went by. {snail:face sleeping} Snail's eyes grew heavy. Then the first bird sang. {sfx:bird solo} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 16s} And as the sun peeked over the hill, Flower {flower:live resume} opened her petals wide again, and smiled. {snail:face happy} [happily] Good morning, Snail! {flower:hearts} You waited for me? {snail:live} Snail tucked into his shell, a little shy… then peeked out and looked around. Every flower in the meadow was opening. {butterfly:enter} Butterfly fluttered by, too. {butterfly:live} She closed her wings to rest… then opened them wide. [whispers] Good morning, {butterfly:hearts} meadow.

es-ES.title: Flor se cierra de noche
es-ES.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.3} {canvas:sunset 0.7 22s} [softly] Cuando el sol se ponía, {flower:enter} Flor {flower:pulse} volvió la cara hacia la última luz calentita. Luego {flower:live hold} plegó sus pétalos amarillos, uno a uno, hasta quedarse hecha un capullo. Despacito, despacito, llegó {snail:enter} Caracol arrastrándose. {snail:face surprised} [gasps] ¿Flor? {snail:shake} ¿Estás bien? Pero Flor no contestó. {canvas:night 0.7 20s} {snail:face sad} [sad] Caracol no sabía qué hacer. Así que se quedó. Toda la noche estuvo a su lado. {sfx:crickets} Cantaron los grillos. Pasó la luna. {snail:face sleeping} A Caracol se le cerraban los ojos. Entonces cantó el primer pájaro. {sfx:bird solo} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 16s} Y mientras el sol asomaba por la colina, Flor {flower:live resume} volvió a abrir sus pétalos, y sonrió. {snail:face happy} [happily] ¡Buenos días, Caracol! {flower:hearts} ¿Me has esperado? {snail:live} Caracol se metió en su concha, un poquito vergonzoso… luego asomó y miró alrededor. Todas las flores del prado se estaban abriendo. Llegó {butterfly:enter} Mariposa revoloteando, también. {butterfly:live} Juntó las alas para descansar… y luego las abrió de par en par. [whispers] Buenos días, {butterfly:hearts} prado.

crickets.prompt: soft night crickets in a meadow, calm and sleepy

bird.prompt: a single small bird singing the first gentle notes of dawn
